4365.title: Ce soir, je dors chez toi

bioEn: Arnaud Stefani is a French  director of photography widely recognized for his modern approach to beauty commercials.
Arnaud has worked as a director of photography on major beauty campaigns worldwide.
His very special collaboration with acclaimed director Jean Pierre Philippot was extremely creative and together they signed powerful international campaigns.
He loves fashion, beauty but above all he loves to shoot faces...
